description: An older woman hangs rain clouds on a washing line in a sunlit courtyard while a fox drinks from a puddle below.
A sleeping polar bear floats inside a submerged train carriage with a tiny brass diving helmet on its head and golden fish nearby.
A gardener kneels on a tiled rooftop beside a giant cracked egg containing a lit spiral staircase, with pigeons along the roof.
A woman holding a blue umbrella crosses a harp-shaped rope bridge above snowy mountains under a starry sky.
A rabbit pushes a small moon across flour on a kitchen table beside a rolling pin and pear, with a meadow visible through an open metal door.
A boy in a red coat stands on a giant leaf floating on a mountain lake, with a carnival wheel visible underwater.
A silver-haired woman sews star-filled fabric at a sewing machine while an orange cat reaches toward a glowing star on the floor.
A giraffe peers into a snow-covered lighthouse among sunflowers, with golden light illuminating roots beneath the soil.
A man holding an orange paper bird sits inside a giant hourglass beneath a floating green island while stone birds fly outside.
A red octopus plays an upright piano on a stormy beach as white butterflies rise from the keys, with yellow boots beside it.
An older man carries an open doorway showing snowy mountains through a lavender field while a white goat wearing a key follows.
Two children lower a wooden ladder into a cracked flowerpot containing a small town, curling green plants and chimney bubbles.
